en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographic views. The left image shows a rural hillside village with several houses and a church featuring a bulbous (onion) dome tower, surrounded by forested hills. The right image shows a small memorial column or commemorative pillar set among tall trees, with many wooden benches and tables arranged around it, resembling a forest beer garden or rest area. Printed caption text in German appears beneath the images, along with a small number at the lower left.
